## Body

An empty server map does not mean the managed config file should disappear. `harness/scripts/link-global.ts` links `.omp/mcp.json` without requiring any servers, while `doctorOmp` checks that the home config is the expected repo symlink. With `{"mcpServers":{}}`, fresh link, idempotent relink and doctor all passed in isolated fixtures during PR 230 review.

An existing real MCP config remains protected: link refuses to clobber it and doctor reports link drift. Do not weaken that preservation guard to make the empty-config rollout appear healthy; restoring a replaced symlink is a separate operator action.

Harness opportunity: `harness/scripts/link-global.test.ts` currently seeds `{}`. Using the actual `mcpServers:{}` shape and asserting zero entries would pin the no-MCP policy rather than merely proving generic file linking. No live machine settings were changed for this proof.
